name: glm-content
description: Content production plugin bundling four skills: glm-blog-writer (long-form and blog writing with a distinct author voice), glm-seo-content-writer (SEO-oriented writing and search-optimized articles), glm-storyboard-manager (story planning, character development, chapter writing, timeline tracking and consistency checking for fiction projects) and glm-ai-news-collectors (multi-source AI news search with layered ranking). Trigger for blog drafts, SEO articles, novel or screenplay planning and tech-news topic gathering. Zero SDK, zero API keys; outputs land in the user's working directories.

interface.shortDescription: Four writing skills: blog long-form, SEO articles, fiction storyboard management and AI news collection.
interface.longDescription: GLM Content Writing bundles the content-production stack. glm-blog-writer drafts long-form posts and articles with a distinct author voice and style profiles; glm-seo-content-writer produces search-optimized content with a deterministic local checklist auditor (seocheck.py) for title length, meta description, H1/H2 keyword placement and FAQ depth; glm-storyboard-manager manages fiction projects (story planning, character development, chapter writing, timeline tracking, consistency checking); glm-ai-news-collectors runs multi-dimensional layered search for AI news and ranks items by heat — its search execution routes to the glm-web plugin's skills. Zero SDK, zero API keys.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-content plugin skills: <写博客长文 / 写 SEO 文章 / 小说分镜与一致性 / AI 新闻聚合>
